messages:
maria: heads up — deploybot flagged a hotfix candidate for embed-service (v2.3.1). High error spike on v2.3.0 in eu-west1. requesting expedited approval to push v2.3.1 now.

deploy-bot: automated alert: 2023-08-15T14:02:34Z - embed-service v2.3.0 error-rate >= 2.8% on eu-west1. Suggested rollback window: 20m.

jonathan: on call, pinging SRE to triage. any perf regressions noted with 2.3.1?

sre-oncall: running preflight checks: k8s pod churn low, no OOMs. replayed failing requests against v2.3.1 image locally — no crash. collecting rolling logs now.

maria: TL;DR — v2.3.1 includes a retry bugfix for a race condition that caused spurious 5xxs. small binary patch. no config changes. we should be able to do expedited rollout. request: skip extended canary (10m canary -> straight ramp 0->100 over 10m) to reduce user impact.

carol: need release notes link and changelog snippet before i sign off.

maria: release notes: https://internal.releases/redwood/embed-service/2.3.1 — snippet: "Fix: race in retry path causing intermittent 502s under high concurrency. No DB schema or config changes."

product: checked, user-facing change negligible. +1 for expedite.

security: confirmed: no secret or credential changes, image scanned and passes policy (SNYK: none).

ben-ops: for expedited flows we require stated rollback criteria. propose rollback if: 1) error-rate > 1% across 5m, or 2) p95 latency delta > 300ms for 5m, or 3) increase in client timeouts > 0.5%. agree?

sre-oncall: agree to those thresholds. i'll open a monitoring alert and own the rollback action. i'll set a runbook link: /runbooks/embed-hotfix-rollback.md

maria: ack. also tagging release-note in the change log and will update the deploy ticket. deploy command ready.

jonathan: preflight checklist done? do we have graceful fallback policy?

sre-oncall: yes — traffic can be shifted back to v2.3.0 or east region. autoscaler disabled for the window.

maria: executing now. command: `/deploy release embed-service v2.3.1 --window=express --ramp=10m`

deploy-bot: canary phase started: 3 pods in eu-west1. metrics stream: https://metrics.internal/embed-service/eu-west1/canary

maria: requesting final expedite ack — need 3 approvals to bypass full canary. pls react with :thumbsup: or reply.

carol: :thumbsup: — docs + release notes attached.

product: :thumbsup:

ben-ops: :thumbsup: — noted rollback criteria.

deploy-bot: approve_count=3/3. scheduling ramp: 0% -> 100% over 10m starting 2023-08-15T14:10:00Z.

sre-oncall: watching dashboards. alert thresholds set. will post updates on metrics and error-rate every 2m.

maria: posting short release note in #release-notes after completion.

deploy-bot: ramping: 25% at 14:12, 50% at 14:14, 75% at 14:16, 100% at 14:20.

sre-oncall: 14:14 metrics snapshot — error-rate down to 0.2%, p95 latency stable. no client-timeout increase. all green so far. :white_check_mark:

maria: copy. continuing ramp. thanks all.

deploy-bot: deploy complete: v2.3.1 active at 100% in eu-west1 (2023-08-15T14:20:09Z).

sre-oncall: post-deploy checks running — 10m window, will call rollback if thresholds breached. so far 12m in and stable.

maria: release-notes posted: https://internal.releases/redwood/embed-service/2.3.1/notes — added changelog and ticket refs.

jonathan: created follow-up ticket RL-4241 to add better unit test coverage for retry branch.

ben-ops: closing expedite window — please file a postmortem if any regressions appear.

maria: thanks everyone. closing thread.
